tools.description: Run a shell command. The session workspace is the working directory, so relative paths resolve there and no cd is needed unless you mean to work elsewhere. Returns combined stdout+stderr.

approval_prefix.description: Optional: when this command will need approval and is part of a routine you expect to repeat, propose the command prefix the human may remember for the rest of the session, e.g. ["git", "pull"]. It must be the command's own leading words, at least two; interpreter, deleter, and escalator heads are never remembered.

run_in_background.description: Run asynchronously and return a task id immediately.
